subject: MSA & Order Form kickoff — BluePeak (data residency & SLA notes)
messages:
From: Amanda Torres <amanda.torres@bluepeak.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluepeak.com
Date: 2027-04-19T09:12:00Z
Subject: MSA & Order Form — kickoff and a couple of questions

Hi Lukas,

Thanks for the warm intro — BluePeak is excited to get started. I attached a short requirements doc (BluePeak_Requirements.docx) with the key technical and compliance constraints. Two items for legal to flag up-front:

- Data residency: EU customer data must remain in EU regions (we'll need a clause limiting processing to EU regions and a commitment around data export controls).
- SLA / uptime credits: because this is a customer-facing product, we need a clear SLA for high-availability and a simple remedy (credits) if we miss the target.

We have a target go-live window around 2027-06-01 and a procurement cutoff of 2027-05-10 for internal approvals. Can you share Redwood's standard MSA and an early redline route so we can confirm timelines?

Also copying our procurement team for commercial timeline visibility.

Thanks,
Amanda Torres
Head of Platform Partnerships
BluePeak Systems

Attachment: BluePeak_Requirements.docx (docx)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Torres <amanda.torres@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — kickoff and a couple of questions

Amanda — thanks for the clear asks and the requirements doc. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- We will start from Redwood's current MSA (I asked Legal Ops to pull the latest template).
- Data residency: noted — Legal will propose a limited data locality clause scoped to EU region and list the operational steps (region pinning + audit logs).
- SLA: Sales has requested a narrowly scoped uptime SLO with credits (not wholesale SLA rewrite) — I'll flag any exceptions that require exec approval.
- Timeline: internal procurement cutoff 2027-05-10 is tight but doable if we keep to the plan below.

Proposed near-term plan:
1) Legal Ops (Laura) to produce template + initial redlines by EOD 4/19.
2) Commercial (Rishi) to confirm committed volumes and billing terms by 4/20.
3) Sync meeting — 30 min with Legal/Procurement on 4/21 to walk redlines and timelines.

Attaching a party_sheet template for you to complete (party_sheet.xlsx). Can you confirm who on your side will sign and the preferred billing entity?

Best,
Lukas
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: party_sheet.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T13:27:00Z
Subject: redwood_MSA_template_v3.pdf + initial redlines (data residency + indemnity)

Lukas / Rishi — attaching the current MSA template with preliminary redlines focused on the items Amanda called out. High-level notes:

- Data residency: inserted a Region Restriction clause (Section 3.2) that limits processing to EU regions where requested and includes customer-driven export controls. This is narrow and operationally enforceable.
- SLA: proposed a Tiered Availability SLO (Annex B) with simple credit mechanics; asked Commercial to confirm whether credit levels are commercially acceptable.
- Indemnity and liability: tightened the cap language to protect Redwood while offering a carve for data breaches tied to Redwood negligence.

I did one-line comments (see inline) where we may need external counsel input (export restrictions language; requested vendor insurance proof). If BluePeak insists on a global data transfer clause beyond our standard, we'll need a leadership exception.

Next: Lukas to share the redlines with BluePeak and collect counterpoints. If BluePeak asks for SOC2 evidence, we can provide our latest attestation PDF.

Laura Bennett
Legal Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_MSA_template_v3.pdf (pdf)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Torres <amanda.torres@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T15:02:00Z
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — commercial points and timeline

Amanda — quick commercial note from our side to keep timelines intact:

- Target start: 2027-06-01 (as noted). We can meet that with signed paperwork by 2027-05-10 and a technical kickoff the week after.
- Committed usage: can you confirm expected monthly token volume or an initial committed tier? That will determine order-form pricing.
- Billing terms: Standard is Net 30; do you have a preferred alternative? Longer terms will push the procurement review.

If you can confirm volume and billing entity by 4/20 EOD, Legal and I can prioritize the order form and pricing worksheet.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Amanda Torres <amanda.torres@bluepeak.com>

Date: 2027-04-20T08:16:00Z
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — commercial points and timeline

Thanks Rishi — a couple items from procurement/legal: 

- Volume: initial tier is 10M tokens/month (we expect ramp over 6 months).
- Billing: BluePeak prefers Net 60 if acceptable — otherwise we will need internal budget approvals which could shift the procurement cutoff. Can Redwood accommodate Net 60 for this pilot?
- Security: we require SOC2 Type II evidence and completion of a short security questionnaire (attached).

If Net 60 is a hard stop, please let us know ASAP so we can decide whether to seek internal budget carve-outs.

Amanda

Attachment: bluepeak_security_questionnaire.pdf (pdf)

- BluePeak to return completed party_sheet.xlsx + preferred billing entity by 2027-04-20 EOD (Amanda).
- Commercial (Rishi) to consider Net 60 impact and propose an approval path by 4/20 EOD.

- Security: we'll provide SOC2 attestation PDF and begin the questionnaire; Legal may request vendor counsel input for any export-control language.

Proposed 30-min legal + procurement sync: 2027-04-21 09:00-09:30 CET — https://meet.redwood.ai/sync/lnk-9a2f7

If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and include a short agenda (redlines, billing terms, next steps).

Best,
Lukas
